description: Local-first crash/diag symptom catalog for CI (no AI tokens). autoFixable=true means a known in-tree fix path exists — NOT auto-PR. OOM root cause is LiveData settings overlay (P148/P156), not fingerprints.json size.

keywords: Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
patterns.regex: heap limit|JavaScript heap out of memory|Allocation failed
patterns.rootCause: Homey Pro ~64MB heap: LiveDataUpdater merged oversized GitHub Pages fingerprint segments into Homey settings (live_data_overlay), not a multi-MB data/fingerprints.json boot load (tip fingerprints ≈15KB; mfs_db is .homeyignore'd).
patterns.suggestedFix: LiveDataUpdater caps (overlay ≤1500, store ≤~180KB), version gate before segments, clear bad store, heap skip (P148). Tip Test ≥9.0.541.

keywords: Tuya DP query timeout on sleepy device
patterns.rootCause: Aggressive EF00/COMMON_DPS polling on sleepy IAS battery devices that only wake on zone notifications.
patterns.suggestedFix: DataRecoveryManager: skip aggressive EF00 on IAS without EF00; no COMMON_DPS on sleepy (P148/P157).

patterns.regex: setTimeout.*(undefined|is not a function)|homey\.setTimeout is not a function
patterns.rootCause: Native/homey timer on destroyed device instance.
Unbound this.error / this.log passed to .catch after destroy.
Capability missing from compose or device mid-destroy.
DynamicCapabilityManager missing auditCapabilities on older stable builds.
patterns.suggestedFix: typeof guard + method on DCM (stable backport)

patterns.regex: Route error|No network route|queue full|MAC channel access
patterns.rootCause: Mesh saturation; often aggressive polling of sleepy devices or RF coexistence.
patterns.suggestedFix: Skip sleepy DP blast; RF coexistence guide (Zigbee 15/20/25 vs Wi-Fi 1/6/11). Not FeatureFallbackRouter auto-cache.
